title: The Lighthouse Was Pointing the Wrong Way
audience_intent: Teens and adults who enjoy short fantasy/mystery fiction. Classify the actual final edit before publication.
narration: Our town had a lighthouse. But there was no ocean. Every night, I lit it anyway. Then a paper boat landed beside me. There was a message inside. Turn the beam down. So I did. The clouds opened. And far below... another lighthouse answered. We weren't alone. We'd just been looking the wrong way.
